Odds (SBD): Turkey +270 / D +290 / Belgium -115; Armenia +125 / Cyprus +200; Italy +320 / D +290 / France -135; Czechia +1000 / Spain -455; England -400 / Croatia +900; Montenegro -323 / Latvia +750; Albania -105 / Finland +290; San Marino +1600 / Belarus -1000.

- **Italy v France (2:45 PM ET) - lean Italy or draw (Italy +0.5).** France are without Mbappe, Dembele, Thuram, Ekitike, Saliba, Kounde, Kalulu, Kone and Tchouameni; Italy (home, San Siro, needs a win, drew 1-1 in Paris) are missing Kean, Raspadori, Di Lorenzo, Mancini. Market still makes France ~51-53%. Strong team-news reason but no model probabilities found, so the soccer rule (two models + news) is not met. Lean only.
- England v Croatia: Opta England 67.2 / draw ~18 / Croatia 14.8 vs market ~76 / 15 / 9.5. One model says England are overpriced, but Croatia have lost three straight, name four uncapped players and lost the last meeting 7-0. Pass.
- Turkey v Belgium, Czechia v Spain, Albania v Finland, Montenegro v Latvia, Armenia v Cyprus, San Marino v Belarus: tipster picks only, no models. Pass.
No bets.
